textos.texto: What time is it? It is half past six in the morning and Ana is always early. She is never late and she is usually on time. Her work is from eight o'clock to two o'clock. At noon she is with Paul for half an hour. In the afternoon she studies, usually at a quarter past four. She rarely studies before four. In the evening she is often with Laura, and sometimes they are with friends. At midnight it is very late for Ana and the night is short. In Peru it is two hours before. Now it is nine in the evening here, so in Peru it is seven. Her clock is here and every minute has sixty seconds. One second! says Ana. I come right away. Her mother says: it is very late for you! Yes, but tomorrow is Saturday! A quarter of an hour after, Ana is in bed.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Qué hora es al principio del texto?
¿Con qué frecuencia estudia antes de las cuatro?
¿A qué hora estudia normalmente por la tarde?
¿Cuánto tiempo está con Paul al mediodía?
En Perú son dos horas menos.

textos.texto: What time is it now? It is a quarter to nine. Are you always on time, Marc? Yes, I am usually on time and I am never late. Sometimes I am early. Good! The time with Laura is at ten o'clock. Ten? That is late for me. I am in bed before midnight and I am early in the morning. No problem, and at half past nine? Very good. One hour before. What time is it in Peru now? It is two hours before: a quarter to seven in the evening. In the afternoon I am often in the office and I am rarely with friends. At noon I have half an hour, and after, one hour of work. Now it is nine o'clock! Right away, Marc, right away! A minute is a minute and a second is a second.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Qué hora es al empezar la conversación?
¿A qué hora queda Marc con Laura?
¿Con qué frecuencia está Marc con amigos por la tarde?
¿Qué hora es en Perú en ese momento?
Marc y Laura se ven en la oficina.
Marc está en la cama antes de medianoche.

textos.texto: It is a quarter past six in the morning. Ana is always early and she is never late. Her work is from eight o'clock to two o'clock, and at noon she has half an hour. In the afternoon she usually studies at half past four. She rarely studies before four. In the evening she is often with Laura. At ten o'clock it is night and at midnight it is very late. Her clock has hours, minutes and seconds. One hour has sixty minutes and one minute has sixty seconds. Sometimes Ana is soon in bed, and sometimes she is late. Right away! she says. A quarter of an hour and I am here.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Con qué frecuencia estudia antes de las cuatro?

textos.texto: What time is it now? It is a quarter to eight. I am usually on time and I am never late. Sometimes I am early. In the morning I am here at eight o'clock. At noon I have half an hour and after, one hour of work. In the afternoon I am often in the office. In the evening, at nine, I am with my friends. At eleven o'clock I am in bed, and at midnight I am always in bed. The night is short! Before eight in the morning it is early, and after ten in the evening it is late. One second, please! Right away!

preguntas.enunciado: ¿A qué hora está con sus amigos?
¿A qué hora está en la cama?
A medianoche siempre está en la cama.

textos.texto: It is twenty past three in the afternoon. Marie is never late: she is usually early and always on time. Her work is from nine o'clock to five o'clock, and at noon she has half an hour. In the morning she is here at a quarter to nine. She rarely works after five. In the evening, at half past eight, she is with Laura. At eleven o'clock she is in bed and at midnight she is always in bed. The night is short! One hour has sixty minutes and one minute has sixty seconds. Her clock is here. Sometimes she is soon in bed, but she is never late in the morning. A quarter of an hour, and right away she is here.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Con qué frecuencia trabaja después de las cinco?
¿A qué hora está en la cama?
